text.p: BLANTYRE, Nov 14 (Reuter) These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A two-hour hail storm on Tuesday struck seven unconcious and blew the roofs off more than 30 houses in two Blantyre townships. Hospital sources have not reported any deaths.

- The Reserve Bank of Malawi as traditional advisor to government on Wednesday testified and vindicated The Democrat newspaper that is currently being sued for defamation by a former dducation minister.

- The ruling United Democratic Front (UDF) party on Wednesday pulled out of a tripartite meeting with two opposition parties, the Malawi Congress Party (MCP) and Alliance for Democracy (AFORD), aimed at resolving the parliamentary boycott and other democratic ifferences.
